blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 63 in June to 43 in October (−31.7%), and it took 28.6% of the city’s 154 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 23 in June to 20 in October (−13.0%), and it took 28.6% of the city’s 42 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Sunshine Hills Woods for detached houses in July, October (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, September (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Lots and land in Sunshine Hills Woods
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Strata vs freehold position, as stated: predominantly freehold detached houses; strata appears in the named townhome complexes at the area's edges.

Lot character — zone minimums, as stated (zoning number contested): single-detached minimum lots run RS1 at 4,000 m² (width 30 m, average depth 30 m), RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² or 460 m², RS6 at 390 m² (width 13 m, depth 30 m) and RS7 at 335 m² (width 11 m); duplex minimums run RD1 at 836 m², RD2 and RD3 at 4,000 m², and RD4 at 504 m²; there is no RD5 zone. These are bylaw-ladder minimums, not a claim that every lot is that size.
Cross-reference — Sunridge Estates (6712 Baker Rd, NWS1316)
Never-cite note applied

ALR vs non-ALR split: OCP Map 2 shows no Agricultural designation for this part of North Delta; property-level ALR status is a check through the Agricultural Land Commission. No ALR percentage split is stated.
Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home, as the City states it for serviced single-family homes.
Buildable-area caution — Cougar Creek: Cougar Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse running through Surrey and Delta per City material, with City work on creek bank stabilization in Cougar Canyon.

Market context, labelled correctly: SnapStats recorded Sunshine Hills Woods Detached inventory 50 / sales 3 / sales ratio 6% (the softest detached ratio of the four North Delta sub-areas in September 2026) and Condos & Townhomes inventory 22 / sales 2 / sales ratio 9%; the parent community (North Delta) detached median was $1,100,000 that month. SnapStats has no land category (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined only; North Delta is a SnapStats-covered community — South Delta is not, and that coverage does not make any figure a land figure) — no detached figure is presented as a land figure.

blocks.text: Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta, BC — the southern tier of North Delta, around Watershed Park and Cougar Canyon.
Nearby areas: Scottsdale to the north-east across Scott Road, Nordel to the north, Panorama Ridge (Surrey) to the south across 64 Avenue, Burns Bog to the west beyond Watershed Park.
Search / alternate names: "Sunshine Hills" and "Sunshine Woods" separately (the two official City neighbourhood names); "Watershed Park" area; "Cougar Canyon" for the north-west pocket.

Roads and transit: 72 Avenue and 64 Avenue run east-west; Kittson Parkway cuts through the Watershed Park area; Scott Road (120 Street) is the east side; Highway 91 access is via 64 Avenue. Route 340 runs Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via Scott Road, 64 Avenue, Kittson Parkway, Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge, through the Watershed Park edge; route 364 runs along the south edge; route 319 runs along the north edge; the R6 RapidBus runs on Scott Road at the east side.
Schools: School District 37 catchments are address-based. Listings for the Nicholson Road pocket name Cougar Canyon Elementary and Seaquam Secondary — the elementary result differs by address.

Parks: Watershed Park, 11600 Kittson Pkwy, is described by the City as Delta's largest park, with eleven kilometres of gravel trails; Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Ave, and Westview Park is at 6500 Westview Dr.

ALR rules — framework only, no Agricultural designation documented for this area: where a parcel is in the ALR, subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); BC Assessment farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

Watershed Park is Delta's largest park — and it shapes what land can ever be built on beside it. Watershed Park, 11600 Kittson Pkwy, has eleven kilometres of gravel trails; Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Ave. The park / canyon / Burns Bog side of the sub-area is open-space and streamside ground, not lot inventory.

No recreation centre or shopping centre inside the working grid was confirmed. The North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue serves North Delta, and George Mackie Library is at 8440 112th Street in Nordel — a lot here is bought for the park / canyon setting, with a drive for facilities.
The softest detached month in North Delta was here. Pricing land value off the North Delta community median alone misleads on tiny, soft numbers.
Delta's flat-rate utility fee is a line item land buyers forget. The City's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home — a fixed annual cost outside property tax.

Sunshine Hills and Sunshine Woods were neighbourhoods 12 and 13 in the former North Delta Area Plan. City reports that predate July 2024 may refer to the earlier area plans; read them against the current OCP.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills / Woods: streets and boundaries

items.t: The City's own naming is layered: its tree-protection work lists Sunshine, Sunshine Woods, Sunshine Hills, Sunshine Village, Westview and Cougar Canyon as separate neighbourhoods from the 2011 North Delta Area Plan.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills / Woods: the housing stock

items.t: Sunshine Hills Park at 11195 Bond Boulevard, with pickleball, tennis courts, playgrounds and trails, sits inside the housing grid rather than at its edge.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills / Woods: rules that affect buyers

items.t: If adopted, the pilot's bylaw amendments would be reviewed after two years; Cougar Canyon, Sunshine Hills and Scottsdale showed the highest interest in taking part.
Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) also applies on these lots, so a coach house or garden suite proposal and the tree rules can land on the same lot at once.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills / Woods: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Seaquam Secondary students from Sunshine Hills Elementary walk to the secondary school for orientation — the two schools are close enough that the district treats the trip as a walking field trip needing no consent form.

Burns Bog, the largest raised bog on the west coast of the Americas, sits north of this area; over 2,300 hectares of the bog and Delta Nature Reserve were added to Canada's protected areas database in 2025.
The City has built nearly 500 dams in Burns Bog to raise the water table and reduce wildfire risk — the bog's fire risk is managed, not absent.
Cougar Canyon and Watershed Park are named by the City among Delta's key natural areas, alongside the Delta Nature Reserve and Burns Bog.

Survey invitations for the tree pilot went to 2,693 properties across seven North Delta neighbourhoods, so a Sunshine Hills buyer is voting on rules alongside Westview, Cougar Canyon and Scottsdale owners.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills / Woods: getting around

items.t: Scott Road (120 Street) is the transit spine: the R6 Scott Road RapidBus links Scott Road Station and Newton Exchange every 7.5 minutes at peak and 15 minutes off-peak, from 5 a.m. to 1 a.m. on weekdays.
Route 340 runs from Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via 64 Avenue, Kittson Parkway and Highway 91 over the Alex Fraser Bridge, along this area's south edge.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills / Woods: risks and due diligence

items.t: Ravine and stream rules are the lot-level check here: Cougar Canyon and the Watershed's streams mean setbacks and tree retention can limit a building envelope, and the pending tree-protection pilot could add rules after you buy.
Wildfire interface is a real, managed risk beside Burns Bog and the canyon forests; the City's bog dams exist specifically to mitigate it.

faq.a: The bylaw ladder runs RS7 at 335 m² up to RS1 at 4,000 m² for single-detached, and RD4 at 504 m² up to RD1 at 836 m² / RD2–RD3 at 4,000 m² for duplex — the parcel's zone decides. Subdivision and servicing requirements are confirmed with the City.
faq.q: How small can a lot be, and can I subdivide?

faq.a: Delta's SSMUH regulations allow garden suites and coach houses in combination with single detached and duplex dwellings where the zoning applies, and SSMUH is permitted on all single-detached and duplex lots citywide under Bylaws 8394 and 8395 (adopted June 24, 2024) — confirm the parcel's zone first.
faq.q: Can I add a suite, coach house or garden suite?

faq.a: Possibly — the creek is salmon-bearing, streamside setback detail is lot-specific, and any property within 30 m of a stream is in the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area. Check the setback before valuing a lot's buildable area.
faq.q: Does Cougar Creek cut into my buildable area?

faq.a: OCP: consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024). Zoning: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, parcel by parcel; confirm a specific lot's zone with the City.
faq.q: Which OCP and zoning bylaw apply?

faq.a: Generally yes if the seller is a developer/business or the lot is newly subdivided; generally no for an individual's personal-use resale, per CRA GI-003.
faq.q: Will GST apply on a vacant lot?

faq.a: Only if that side is legally separate — a strata lot in a 2-lot strata plan, or its own fee-simple lot from a subdivision. Check the title first.
faq.q: Can I buy just one side of a duplex in Sunshine Hills Woods?

faq.a: The duplex evidence here is the form class under Delta's RD duplex zones and the SSMUH framework.
faq.q: Is there a named duplex development in Sunshine Hills Woods?

faq.a: Delta's amendments state four units on all residential properties in the City (the six-unit tier is the Scott Road frequent-transit band) — added-unit potential on the lot, not a right to split it into half-duplex titles.

Ask the City before assuming yes. Council launched the tree-protection pilot process in October 2025 because of concern about mature canopy loss in Sunshine Hills, and owners in Cougar Canyon, Sunshine Hills and Scottsdale are now being asked whether they support bylaw amendments for their neighbourhoods.
faq.q: Can I remove the big trees on a lot?

faq.a: It is Delta's largest park, at 11600 Kittson Parkway, with trails and a viewpoint, and its streams host an annual release of 25,000 chum salmon fry each April with tree planting and exhibitors including the Cougar Creek Streamkeepers. Lots backing onto it trade a park boundary for stream and trail rules.
